points.description: Convolutional layer: states that it has kernels (or filters) that convolve over the input image.
Activation layer: states that it applies a ReLU activation function.
Pooling layer: states that it uses max pooling or average pooling.
Fully connected layer(s) (one or more) followed by a softmax layer.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four required elements named with their technical terms: a convolutional layer with kernels/filters convolving over the input image, a ReLU activation layer, a max or average pooling layer, and one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax layer. Each element is marked separately at 0.5, and a vague description such as "some layers that process the image" earns nothing for that element. Extra correct layers or details do not cost marks, but a wrong statement about an element (for example, calling pooling a convolution, or placing softmax before the fully connected layers) cancels that element's mark. There are no part marks at this level because each element is either stated precisely or not.
